name: v2 Squid egress burst
description: Five or more distinct external destinations requested through the Squid forward proxy by one authenticated identity from one source address within 10 minutes — the shape of staged exfiltration or tool download over the sanctioned egress path. Routine host activity routes no egress through the proxy. user.name is the proxy basic-auth identity; url.original is the destination (host:port for CONNECT).
